Moments & Co. — Wedding Photography, Hyderabad

Moments & Co. is a Hyderabad photography studio covering traditional Telugu and
Hyderabadi weddings, with a balanced mix of posed family portraits and candid
coverage. They are a dependable mid-market choice with consistent reviews.

Their standard two-event package (two photographers, one cinematographer) is
₹1,15,000, including a printed album and an online gallery.
